turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that, and on what basis.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
You asked for this meeting, Hale, so skip the pleasantries. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went into the gradebook, yes or no?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, and the company that sells these tools says in its own guide they shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student; I have that printed in my bag. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything. And you still haven't answered me: was Owen heard before that zero went in?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, and one Stanford study had them flagging 61 percent of essays by non-native English writers. So apart from a machine's opinion, what else do you have, Hale?
So I had to give him a zero.

"Had to." Nothing in your own procedure says you had to; 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and 4.1 says you speak to Owen first. So you decided first and asked questions later, and unless you have something real on that desk, I'm walking upstairs to the principal when we're done here.
I hope you understand my position.
Your position is a software score and a zero you entered without calling anyone. I'm writing that down. Do you have anything with a date on it that ties to Owen's own work, or am I going upstairs?
